params.body:
Three screens are about the platform itself and about nobody's cars: what it does as a business, how much work goes through it, and whether the machine is running. Activiteit moved inside Inzichten on 26 September; this is the same move for the last one.

The dropdown had shrunk to two items, and a dropdown for two things is a dropdown for two things.

## The menu disappears as a consequence, not as a goal

With no visible children the navigation falls through to its plain-item branch, so **Inzichten becomes a link again** instead of a menu holding one thing. Nothing in the navigation had to change for that — it already worked that way; `operations` simply stops being a visible child.

Hidden and **not deleted**, for the reason #825 established: `Access` derives the right from the first part of the route name (`operations` out of `operations.index`), so deleting the row takes the right with it and `/operations` — which is in bookmarks — would bounce to the home page instead of opening the tab.

## The tab

`insights/_werking.blade.php` carries the intro line and `<livewire:admin.operations />`. The old page's `<h1>` is gone: the tab already carries the name, and a title underneath saying the same thing is the second time. `operations/index.blade.php` is deleted, since nothing renders it any more.

The three tabs now read **Klanten en omzet · Gebruik · Werking**, each named after its question (R P3-16.16).

Access does not widen: `InsightsController::guard()` already refused anyone but a platform administrator, and the Operations component refuses on mount and on every action regardless.

## A test whose premise moved

`AParentKeepsItsOwnPageTest` pins R P1-1.24 — a parent with its own page keeps that page when it gains a child — and used Inzichten with Operations underneath as its material. With Operations hidden there is no visible child any more, so the test had nothing to prove and failed.

The rule is general; those two screens were only the example. The test now **builds** the arrangement it is about: it hangs the row underneath, makes it visible for its own duration, and restores both afterwards (`menus` is MyISAM, so nothing rolls back by itself). Renamed accordingly — it was called "the insights dropdown holds its own page", which is no longer a thing that exists.

`OperationsScreenTest` follows the screen to its tab and gains a test that the old address still redirects.

## Verified

`phpstan` green, `npm run build` green, `pint` green on the added migration. Local suite: the same nine failures as on a clean `main` in my environment. R P3-16.10 updated to cover both hidden items and both redirects.
params.title: Werking becomes the third tab of Inzichten
